description: Defines a CKEditor color dialog plugin, adding a color picker dialog with color selection and highlighting features.

methods.name: clearSelected
methods.description: Clears the selected color highlight and resets the selected color value.

methods.name: updateSelected
methods.description: Updates the selected color based on user interaction.

methods.name: updateHighlight
methods.description: Highlights the color cell when hovered.

methods.name: createColorTable
methods.description: Generates the color palette table for the color picker.
